reason: A file interaction utility that accepts desktop file or folder drops and native file selections, then inserts paths into the DSH input with a documented local fallback for content uploads.

summaries.zh: 支持将文件或文件夹拖入 DSH 窗口，或通过原生文件选择器选取文件，并把路径填入对话输入框。
summaries.en: Accepts desktop file or folder drops and native file selections, then inserts the resulting paths into the DSH conversation input.

capabilities: Reads file and folder paths from desktop drag-and-drop operations
Provides a native file picker with multi-selection
Writes selected paths into the DSH conversation input
May write fallback upload data to a workspace directory
Runs a local PowerShell helper process for drag-and-drop handling
